discovery: Resumed suite passed tests 2 through 32, then stopped at compose measurement accounting test 33. Related compose repair test 43 reproduced the mismatch: historical predicted margin/area 37.5/10000.0 versus current 38.3/9604.0.
decision: Do not require a current optimiser to reproduce historical board dimensions or prediction coordinates. No historical fixture was overwritten and no production gate changed.
new_workflow_contract: The same single ranked edit and all surrounding output remain byte-exact. Only its two finite numeric prediction values may differ: margin must not decrease and positive area must not increase. Explicit negatives reject worse margin, larger area, changed edit, NaN, trailing numeric junk and changed rollback text. Accounting-on/off executions must produce identical current stdout.
prediction_contract: Current candidate area, spill list and term evaluation transport match a direct current replica. Area may not regress against the historical fixture; previously satisfied terms must remain satisfied. Historical term identities, edited JSON and error behaviour remain checked.
independent_evidence_preserved: Frozen measured-board ledgers for both boards, numeric channel-demand/facing kernel fixtures, fixed-input ranking and workflow edit/rollback/exit/call-budget/ledger checks remain exact.
limitation: Direct replica comparison exercises integration/transport, not an independent proof of optimiser arithmetic or physical hardware correctness. Those remain covered separately; no complete goal or fabrication readiness claim.
